novelty_flags.label: Theorem hazard-lift-identification and related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: Add Callaway and Tsyawo (2023), Treatment Effects in Staggered Adoption Designs with Non-Parallel Trends, as the closest omitted no-parallel-trends staggered-ATT comparator and state explicitly why its interactive-fixed-effects functional neither subsumes nor is subsumed by the hazard-lift result.

soundness_flags.label: ass:predictive-rank
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Hsu--Kakade--Zhang condition is full rank of the ordinary emission and transition matrices, not full rank of a stopped two-terminal Hankel operator; retag this as a tailored novel realization condition or cite a source proving the exact stopped-Hankel form.

soundness_flags.label: ass:fixed-hankel-gap
soundness_flags.one_line: A lower singular-value bound for the selected stopped Hankel chart is chart-specific and is not the standard Hsu--Kakade--Zhang separation condition; retag and justify it as a declared regular-chart condition.

soundness_flags.label: ass:fixed-killed-gap
soundness_flags.one_line: A lower bound on the canonical killed operator is not the transition/emission singular-value condition in Hsu--Kakade--Zhang and needs its own tailored regularity justification.

soundness_flags.label: ass:fixed-frame-gap
soundness_flags.one_line: Tran--Kim--Doshi-Velez analyze moment equations involving observable HMM operators, not the proposal's predeclared polynomial-frame matrix V_F; retag this custom rank condition as novel and justify its empirical relevance.

soundness_flags.label: def:gray-zone and prop:collision-gray-zone
soundness_flags.one_line: The lower 'sampling-noise threshold' defining the gray zone is never specified, and the indistinguishable N-sample pair lacks a stated eta-to-N path; define both before asserting gray-zone membership or the N^{-1/4} separation.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:kim-lee-certificate
soundness_flags.one_line: 'Acceptably small HDK residual' and 'precision adequate' have no declared statistic, threshold, or simultaneous decision rule, so the preregistered certificate currently has no determinate predicate.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:hazard-lift-identification
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The result is conditional on known finite K, finite emissions, homogeneous untreated dynamics, sequential hazard timing, and the within-emission-profile hazard restriction.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Point identification is claimed only for P_W in the displayed hazard-lift class, not for unrestricted staggered-adoption panels.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:fixed-chart-inference
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Inference is conditional on one predeclared separated canonical chart and polynomial frame and does not cover collision or adaptive-frame regimes.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The root-N expansion and simultaneous band are claimed only on compact regular subsets of the repaired declared chart stratum.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper parameterizes equivalent minimal two-aliased HMMs through an invertible similarity transformation, nonnegativity constraints, and a connected feasible region; it does not state a causal stopped-panel or ATT functional.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Computer and System Sciences 78(5), 2012
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The HMM rank condition requires positive initial probabilities and full rank of O and T; Theorem 6 controls joint sequence-probability error through singular values of O and P_{2,1}. It does not state a stopped-Hankel, killed-operator, or fixed-chart condition.

Proposition 1 equates a particular spectral HMM estimator with an M-estimator based on P_1, P_{2,1}, and P_{3,x,1}; it does not establish full column rank or a singular-value gap for the proposal's polynomial frame V_F.
The paper defines group-time ATT under staggered adoption, proposes reverse-time nested matching and bootstrap inference, and applies it to Netflix--IPTV outcomes including VoD.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3.3, especially paragraphs on pp. 14--15 beginning 'An important limitation arises'
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For staggered treatment, the paper explains that evolving persistent shocks affecting treatment timing create a selection problem when controls must remain untreated through later periods; its framework is most natural with no intervening adoption or time-invariant unobservables.

Sharpen the legal-lift OEQ into a fixed-(K,T,|Y|) input/output algorithm with quantified semialgebraic variables, constraints, and a termination or complexity bound.
